title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.

title: Ambi Ning Vayassaytho
desc: Ambi, a retired stunt master, sets out on a heartfelt journey to reconnect with his lost love, facing unexpected challenges and rediscovering his purpose along the way.

title: Lakshmi Mahalakshmi
desc: Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.

title: Rakshasudu
desc: After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.

title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.
